surahInfo.name: سُورَةُ البَقَرَة
surahInfo.description: The longest Surah of the Noble Quran, revealed in Madinah over several years. It lays the cornerstone of Islamic belief, worship, legislation, social justice, and ethics, containing pivotal verses like Ayat al-Kursi (255) and the concluding supplications (285-286).

ayahs.keyVerseTitle: Opening of the Surah (Alif Lam Meem)
ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓمٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Alif-Laaam-Meeem

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Alif, Lam, Meem.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: Alif, Lam, Meem.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Alif-Lam-Mim. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Quran and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings].

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: A. L. M.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: Alif. Lam. Mim.

ayahs.keyVerseTitle: Guidance for the God-conscious (Muttaqeen)
ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Zaalikal Kitaabu laa raiba feeh; udal lilmuttaqeen

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: This is the Book in which there is no doubt, a guide for the righteous.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: This is the Book (the Quran), whereof there is no doubt, a guidance to those who are Al-Muttaqun [the pious and righteous persons who fear Allah much (abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds which He has forbidden) and love Allah much (perform all kinds of good deeds which He has ordained)].

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: This is the Book; in it is guidance sure, without doubt, to those who fear Allah;

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt, a guidance unto those who ward off (evil).

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazeena yu'minoona bilghaibi wa yuqeemoonas salaata wa mimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them,

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: Those who believe in the unseen, and perform the prayers, and give from what We have provided for them.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Who believe in the Ghaib and perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat), and spend out of what we have provided for them [i.e. give Zakat, spend on themselves, their parents, their children, their wives, etc., and also give charity to the poor and also in Allah's Cause - Jihad, etc.].

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Who believe in the Unseen, are steadfast in prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them;

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: Who believe in the Unseen, and establish worship, and spend of that We have bestowed upon them;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallazeena yu'minoona bimaa unzila ilaika wa maaa unzila min qablika wa bil Aakhirati hum yooqinoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: And those who believe in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed before you, and are certain of the Hereafter.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: And who believe in (the Quran and the Sunnah) which has been sent down (revealed) to you (Muhammad Peace be upon him) and in [the Taurat (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel), etc.] which were sent down before you and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter. (Resurrection, recompense of their good and bad deeds, Paradise and Hell, etc.).

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: And who believe in the Revelation sent to thee, and sent before thy time, and (in their hearts) have the assurance of the Hereafter.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: And who believe in that which is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) and that which was revealed before thee, and are certain of the Hereafter.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Ulaaa'ika 'alaa hudam mir rabbihim wa ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: These are upon guidance from their Lord. These are the successful.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: They are on (true) guidance from their Lord, and they are the successful.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: They are on (true) guidance, from their Lord, and it is these who will prosper.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: These depend on guidance from their Lord. These are the successful.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena kafaroo sawaaa'un 'alaihim 'a-anzar tahum am lam tunzirhum laa yu'minoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: As for those who disbelieve—it is the same for them, whether you have warned them, or have not warned them—they do not believe.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Verily, those who disbelieve, it is the same to them whether you (O Muhammad Peace be upon him) warn them or do not warn them, they will not believe.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: As to those who reject Faith, it is the same to them whether thou warn them or do not warn them; they will not believe.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: As for the Disbelievers, Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not it is all one for them; they believe not.

ayahs.arabic: خَتَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَعَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِمْ ۖ وَعَلَىٰٓ أَبْصَٰرِهِمْ غِشَٰوَةٌۭ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Khatamal laahu 'alaa quloobihim wa 'alaa sam'i-him wa 'alaaa absaarihim ghishaa watunw wa lahum 'azaabun 'azeem

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Allah has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: God has set a seal on their hearts and on their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. They will have a severe torment.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Allah has set a seal on their hearts and on their hearings, (i.e. they are closed from accepting Allah's Guidance), and on their eyes there is a covering. Theirs will be a great torment.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Allah hath set a seal on their hearts and on their hearing, and on their eyes is a veil; great is the penalty they (incur).

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: Allah hath sealed their hearing and their hearts, and on their eyes there is a covering. Theirs will be an awful doom.

ayahs.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَمَا هُم بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa minan naasi mai yaqoolu aamannaa billaahi wa bil yawmil aakhiri wa maa hum bimu'mineen

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah and the Last Day," but they are not believers.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: Among the people are those who say, “We believe in God and in the Last Day,” but they are not believers.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: And of mankind, there are some (hypocrites) who say: "We believe in Allah and the Last Day" while in fact they believe not.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Of the people there are some who say: "We believe in Allah and the Last Day;" but they do not (really) believe.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: And of mankind are some who say: We believe in Allah and the Last Day, when they believe not.

ayahs.arabic: يُخَٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَمَا يَخْدَعُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Yukhaadi'oonal laaha wallazeena aamanoo wa maa yakhda'oona illaaa anfusahum wa maa yash'uroon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: They [think to] deceive Allah and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: They seek to deceive God and those who believe, but they deceive none but themselves, though they are not aware.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: They (think to) deceive Allah and those who believe, while they only deceive themselves, and perceive (it) not!

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Fain would they deceive Allah and those who believe, but they only deceive themselves, and realise (it) not!

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: They think to beguile Allah and those who believe, and they beguile none save themselves; but they perceive not.

ayahs.arabic: فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ فَزَادَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَرَضًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْذِبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fee quloobihim mara dun fazzdahumul laahu maradan wa lahum 'azaabun aleemum bimaa kaanoo yakziboon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: In their hearts is disease, so Allah has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: In their hearts is sickness, and God has increased their sickness. They will have a painful punishment because of their denial.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: In their hearts is a disease (of doubt and hypocrisy) and Allah has increased their disease. A painful torment is theirs because they used to tell lies.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: In their hearts is a disease; and Allah has increased their disease: And grievous is the penalty they (incur), because they are false (to themselves).

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: In their hearts is a disease, and Allah increaseth their disease. A painful doom is theirs because they lie.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahum laa tufsidoo fil ardi qaalo innamaa nahnu muslihoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: And when it is said to them, “Do not make trouble on earth,” they say, “We are only reformers.”

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: And when it is said to them: "Make not mischief on the earth," they say: "We are only peacemakers."

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: When it is said to them: "Make not mischief on the earth," they say: "Why, we only Want to make peace!"

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: And when it is said unto them: Make not mischief in the earth, they say: We are peacemakers only.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْسِدُونَ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Alaaa innahum humul mufsidoona wa laakil laa yash'uroon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: In fact, they are the troublemakers, but they are not aware.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Verily! They are the ones who make mischief, but they perceive not.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Of a surety, they are the ones who make mischief, but they realise (it) not.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: Are not they indeed the mischief-makers? But they perceive not.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ءَامِنُوا۟ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلنَّاسُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahum aaminoo kamaaa aamanan naasu qaalooo anu'minu kamaaa aamanas sufahaaa'; alaaa innahum humus sufahaaa'u wa laakil laa ya'lamoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: And when it is said to them, “Believe as the people have believed,” they say, “Shall we believe as the fools have believed?” In fact, it is they who are the fools, but they do not know.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: And when it is said to them (hypocrites): "Believe as the people (followers of Muhammad Peace be upon him, Al-Ansar and Al-Muhajirun) have believed," they say: "Shall we believe as the fools have believed?" Verily, they are the fools, but they know not.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: When it is said to them: "Believe as the others believe:" They say: "Shall we believe as the fools believe?" Nay, of a surety they are the fools, but they do not know.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: And when it is said unto them: believe as the people believe, they say: shall we believe as the foolish believe? are not they indeed the foolish? But they know not.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا لَقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ شَيَٰطِينِهِمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa laqul lazeena aamanoo qaalooo aamannaa wa izaa khalw ilaa shayaateenihim qaalooo innaa ma'akum innamaa nahnu mustahzi'oon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: And when they come across those who believe, they say, “We believe”; but when they are alone with their devils, they say, “We are with you; we were only ridiculing.”

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: And when they meet those who believe, they say: "We believe," but when they are alone with their Shayatin (devils - polytheists, hypocrites, etc.), they say: "Truly, we are with you; verily, we were but mocking."

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: When they meet those who believe, they say: "We believe;" but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say: "We are really with you: We (were) only jesting."

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: And when they fall in with those who believe, they say: We believe; but when they go apart to their devils they declare: Lo! we are with you; verily we did but mock.

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ وَيَمُدُّهُمْ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allahu yastahzi'u bihim wa yamudduhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: [But] Allah mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: It is God who ridicules them, and leaves them bewildered in their transgression.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Allah mocks at them and gives them increase in their wrong-doings to wander blindly.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Allah will throw back their mockery on them, and give them rope in their trespasses; so they will wander like blind ones (To and fro).

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: Allah (Himself) doth mock them, leaving them to wander blindly on in their contumacy.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Ulaaa'ikal lazeenash tara wud dalaalata bilhudaa famaa rabihat tijaaratuhum wa maa kaanoo muhtadeen

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: Those are they who have bartered error for guidance; but their trade does not profit them, and they are not guided.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: These are they who have purchased error for guidance, so their commerce was profitless. And they were not guided.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: These are they who have bartered Guidance for error: But their traffic is profitless, and they have lost true direction,

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: These are they who purchase error at the price of guidance, so their commerce doth not prosper, neither are they guided.

ayahs.arabic: مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًۭا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهُۥ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِى ظُلُمَٰتٍۢ لَّا يُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Masaluhum kamasalillazis tawqada naaran falammaaa adaaa'at maa hawlahoo zahabal laahu binoorihim wa tarakahum fee zulumaatil laa yubsiroon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: Their likeness is that of a person who kindled a fire; when it illuminated all around him, God took away their light, and left them in darkness, unable to see.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Their likeness is as the likeness of one who kindled a fire; then, when it lighted all around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness. (So) they could not see.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Their similitude is that of a man who kindled a fire; when it lighted all around him, Allah took away their light and left them in utter darkness. So they could not see.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: Their likeness is as the likeness of one who kindleth fire, and when it sheddeth its light around him Allah taketh away their light and leaveth them in darkness, where they cannot see,

ayahs.arabic: صُمٌّۢ بُكْمٌ عُمْىٌۭ فَهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Summum bukmun 'umyun fahum laa yarji'oon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: Deaf, dumb, blind. They will not return.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: They are deaf, dumb, and blind, so they return not (to the Right Path).

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Deaf, dumb, and blind, they will not return (to the path).

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: Deaf, dumb and blind; and they return not.

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَٰتٌۭ وَرَعْدٌۭ وَبَرْقٌۭ يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Aw kasaiyibim minas samaaa'i feehi zulumaatunw wa ra'dunw wa barq, yaj'aloona asaabi'ahum feee aazaanihim minas sawaa'iqi hazaral mawt' wallaahu muheetum bilkaafireen

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allah is encompassing of the disbelievers.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: Or like a cloudburst from the sky, in which is darkness, and thunder, and lightning. They press their fingers into their ears from the thunderbolts, in fear of death. But God surrounds the disbelievers.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Or like a rainstorm from the sky, wherein is darkness, thunder, and lightning. They thrust their fingers in their ears to keep out the stunning thunderclap for fear of death. But Allah ever encompasses the disbelievers (i.e. Allah will gather them all together).

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Or (another similitude) is that of a rain-laden cloud from the sky: In it are zones of darkness, and thunder and lightning: They press their fingers in their ears to keep out the stunning thunder-clap, the while they are in terror of death. But Allah is ever round the rejecters of Faith!

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: Or like a rainstorm from the sky, wherein is darkness, thunder and the flash of lightning. They thrust their fingers in their ears by reason of the thunder-claps, for fear of death, Allah encompasseth the disbelievers (in His guidance, His omniscience and His omnipotence).

ayahs.arabic: يَكَادُ ٱلْبَرْقُ يَخْطَفُ أَبْصَٰرَهُمْ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَضَآءَ لَهُم مَّشَوْا۟ فِيهِ وَإِذَآ أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَامُوا۟ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Yakaadul barqu yakhtafu absaarahum kullamaaa adaaa'a lahum mashaw feehi wa izaaa azlama 'alaihim qaamoo; wa law shaaa'al laahu lazahaba bisam'ihim wa absaarihim; innal laaha 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: The lightning almost snatches their sight away. Whenever it illuminates for them, they walk in it; but when it grows dark over them, they stand still. Had God willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. God is capable of everything.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: The lightning almost snatches away their sight, whenever it flashes for them, they walk therein, and when darkness covers them, they stand still. And if Allah willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Certainly, Allah has power over all things.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: The lightning all but snatches away their sight; every time the light (Helps) them, they walk therein, and when the darkness grows on them, they stand still. And if Allah willed, He could take away their faculty of hearing and seeing; for Allah hath power over all things.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: The lightning almost snatcheth away their sight from them. As often as it flasheth forth for them they walk therein, and when it darkeneth against them they stand still. If Allah willed, He could destroy their hearing and their sight. Lo! Allah is able to do all things.

ayahs.keyVerseTitle: Call to Universal Worship of the One Creator
ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa aiyuhan naasu'budoo Rabbakumul lazee khalaqakum wallazeena min qablikum la'allakum tattaqoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous -

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: O people! Worship your Lord who created you and those before you, that you may attain piety.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: O mankind! Worship your Lord (Allah), Who created you and those who were before you so that you may become Al-Muttaqun (the pious - see V. 2:2).

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: O ye people! Adore your Guardian-Lord, who created you and those who came before you, that ye may have the chance to learn righteousness;

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: O mankind! worship your Lord, Who hath created you and those before you, so that ye may ward off (evil).

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِرَٰشًۭا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءًۭ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًۭا لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda firaashanw wassamaaa'a binaaa 'anw wa anzala minassamaaa'i maaa'an fa akhraja bihee minas samaraati rizqal lakum falaa taj'aloo lillaahi andaadanw wa antum ta'lamoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: He who made the earth a habitat for you, and the sky a structure, and sends water down from the sky, and brings out fruits thereby, as a sustenance for you. Therefore, do not assign rivals to God while you know.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Who has made the earth a resting place for you, and the sky as a canopy, and sent down water (rain) from the sky and brought forth therewith fruits as a provision for you. Then do not set up rivals unto Allah (in worship) while you know (that He Alone has the right to be worshipped).

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Who has made the earth your couch, and the heavens your canopy; and sent down rain from the heavens; and brought forth therewith Fruits for your sustenance; then set not up rivals unto Allah when ye know (the truth).

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy; and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you. And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍۢ مِّمَّا نَزَّلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا فَأْتُوا۟ بِسُورَةٍۢ مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ وَٱدْعُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa in kuntum fee raibim mimmaa nazzalnaa 'alaa 'abdinaa fatoo bi Sooratim mim mislihee wad'oo shuhadaaa'akum min doonil laahi in kuntum saadiqeen

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down upon Our Servant [Muhammad], then produce a surah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses other than Allah, if you should be truthful.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: And if you are in doubt about what We have revealed to Our servant, then produce a chapter like these, and call your witnesses apart from God, if you are truthful.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: And if you (Arab pagans, Jews, and Christians) are in doubt concerning that which We have sent down (i.e. the Quran) to Our slave (Muhammad Peace be upon him), then produce a Surah (chapter) of the like thereof and call your witnesses (supporters and helpers) besides Allah, if you are truthful.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: And if ye are in doubt as to what We have revealed from time to time to Our servant, then produce a Sura like thereunto; and call your witnesses or helpers (If there are any) besides Allah, if your (doubts) are true.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: And if ye are in doubt concerning that which We reveal unto Our slave (Muhammad), then produce a surah of the like thereof, and call your witness beside Allah if ye are truthful.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ وَلَن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ ۖ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fail lam taf'aloo wa lan taf'aloo fattaqun Naaral latee waqooduhan naasu walhijaaratu u'iddat lilkaafireen

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: But if you do not—and you will not—then beware the Fire whose fuel is people and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: But if you do it not, and you can never do it, then fear the Fire (Hell) whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: But if ye cannot- and of a surety ye cannot- then fear the Fire whose fuel is men and stones,- which is prepared for those who reject Faith.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: And if ye do it not - and ye can never do it - then guard yourselves against the Fire prepared for disbelievers, whose fuel is of men and stones.

ayahs.arabic: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٍۢ رِّزْقًۭا ۙ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى رُزِقْنَا مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَأُتُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُتَشَٰبِهًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَآ أَزْوَٰجٌۭ مُّطَهَّرَةٌۭ ۖ وَهُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa bashshiril lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati anna lahum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru kullamaa riziqoo minhaa min samaratir rizqan qaaloo haazal lazee ruziqnaa min qablu wa utoo bihee mutashaabihaa, wa lahum feehaaa azwaajum mutahhara tunw wa hum feehaa khaalidoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: And give good news to those who believe and do righteous deeds; that they will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with fruit therefrom as sustenance, they will say, “This is what we were provided with before,” and they will be given the like of it. And they will have pure spouses therein, and they will abide therein forever.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: And give glad tidings to those who believe and do righteous good deeds, that for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise). Every time they will be provided with a fruit therefrom, they will say: "This is what we were provided with before," and they will be given things in resemblance (i.e. in the same form but different in taste) and they shall have therein Azwajun Mutahharatun (purified mates or wives), (having no menses, stools, urine, etc.) and they will abide therein forever.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: But give glad tidings to those who believe and work righteousness, that their portion is Gardens, beneath which rivers flow. Every time they are fed with fruits therefrom, they say: "Why, this is what we were fed with before," for they are given things in similitude; and they have therein companions pure (and holy); and they abide therein (for ever).

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: And give glad tidings (O Muhammad) unto those who believe and do good works; that theirs are Gardens underneath which rivers flow; as often as they are regaled with food of the fruit thereof, they say: this is what was given us aforetime; and it is given to them in resemblance. There for them are pure companions; there for ever they abide.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْىِۦٓ أَن يَضْرِبَ مَثَلًۭا مَّا بَعُوضَةًۭ فَمَا فَوْقَهَا ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۘ يُضِلُّ بِهِۦ كَثِيرًۭا وَيَهْدِى بِهِۦ كَثِيرًۭا ۚ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal laaha laa yastahyeee ai yadriba masalam maa ba'oodatan famaa fawqahaa; faammal lazeena aamanoo faya'lamoona annahul haqqu mir rabbihim wa ammal lazeena kafaroo fayaqooloona maazaaa araadal laahu bihaazaa masalaa; yudillu bihee kaseeranw wa yahdee bihee kaseeraa; wa maa yudillu biheee illal faasiqeen

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Indeed, Allah is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allah intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: God does not shy away from making an example of a gnat, or something above it. As for those who believe, they know that it is the Truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, “What did God intend by this example?” He leads astray many thereby, and He guides many thereby; but He misleads thereby only the evildoers.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Verily, Allah is not ashamed to set forth a parable even of a mosquito or so much more when it is bigger (or less when it is smaller) than it. And as for those who believe, they know that it is the Truth from their Lord, but as for those who disbelieve, they say: "What did Allah intend by this parable?" By it He misleads many, and many He guides thereby. And He misleads thereby only those who are Al-Fasiqun (the rebellious, disobedient to Allah).

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Allah disdains not to use the similitude of things, lowest as well as highest. Those who believe know that it is truth from their Lord; but those who reject Faith say: "What means Allah by this similitude?" By it He causes many to stray, and many He leads into the right path; but He causes not to stray, except those who forsake (the path),-

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: Lo! Allah disdaineth not to coin the similitude even of a gnat. Those who believe know that it is the truth from their Lord; but those who disbelieve say: What doth Allah wish (to teach) by such a similitude? He misleadeth many thereby, and He guideth many thereby; and He misleadeth thereby only miscreants;

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مِيثَٰقِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazeena yanqudoona 'ahdal laahi mim ba'di meesaaqihee wa yaqt'oona maaa amaral laahu biheee ai yoosala wa yufsidoona fil ard; ulaaa'ika hum khaasirron

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: Those who violate God’s covenant after its confirmation, and sever what God has commanded to be joined, and commit evil on earth. These are the losers.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Those who break Allah's Covenant after ratifying it, and sever what Allah has ordered to be joined (as regards Allah's Religion of Islamic Monotheism, and to practise its legal laws on the earth and also as regards keeping good relations with kith and kin), and do mischief on earth, it is they who are the losers.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Those who break Allah's Covenant after it is ratified, and who sunder what Allah Has ordered to be joined, and do mischief on earth: These cause loss (only) to themselves.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: Those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah ordered to be joined, and (who) make mischief in the earth: Those are they who are the losers.

ayahs.arabic: كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَكُنتُمْ أَمْوَٰتًۭا فَأَحْيَٰكُمْ ۖ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Kaifa takfuroona billaahi wa kuntum amwaatan fa ahyaakum summa yumeetukum summa yuhyeekum summaa ilaihi turja'oon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: How can you disbelieve in Allah when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: How can you deny God, when you were dead and He gave you life, then He will put you to death, then He will bring you to life, then to Him you will be returned?

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: How can you disbelieve in Allah? Seeing that you were dead and He gave you life. Then He will give you death, then again will bring you to life (on the Day of Resurrection) and then unto Him you will return.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: How can ye reject the faith in Allah?- seeing that ye were without life, and He gave you life; then will He cause you to die, and will again bring you to life; and again to Him will ye return.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: How disbelieve ye in Allah when ye were dead and He gave life to you! Then He will give you death, then life again, and then unto Him ye will return.

ayahs.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَسَوَّىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ ۚ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Huwal lazee khalaqa lakum maa fil ardi jamee'an summas tawaaa ilas samaaa'i fasaw waahunna sab'a samaa waat; wa Huwa bikulli shai'in Aleem

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: It is He who created for you everything on earth, then turned to the heaven, and made them seven heavens. And He is aware of all things.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: He it is Who created for you all that is on earth. Then He Istawa (rose over) towards the heaven and made them seven heavens and He is the All-Knower of everything.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: It is He Who hath created for you all things that are on earth; Moreover His design comprehended the heavens, for He gave order and perfection to the seven firmaments; and of all things He hath perfect knowledge.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: He it is Who created for you all that is in the earth. Then turned He to the heaven, and fashioned it as seven heavens. And He is knower of all things.

ayahs.keyVerseTitle: Creation of Prophet Adam (AS) & The Angels
ayahs.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى جَاعِلٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَجْعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفْسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسْفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحْنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa iz qaala rabbuka lil malaaa'ikati innee jaa'ilun fil ardi khaleefatan qaalooo ataj'alu feehaa mai yufsidu feehaa wa yasfikud dimaaa'a wa nahnu nusabbihu bihamdika wa nuqaddisu laka qaala inneee a'lamu maa laa ta'lamoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare Your praise and sanctify You?" Allah said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: When your Lord said to the angels, “I am placing a successor on earth.” They said, “Will You place in it someone who will cause corruption in it and shed blood, while we declare Your praises and sanctify You?” He said, “I know what you do not know.”

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: And (remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "Verily, I am going to place (mankind) generations after generations on earth." They said: "Will You place therein those who will make mischief therein and shed blood, - while we glorify You with praises and thanks (Exalted be You above all that they associate with You as partners) and sanctify You." He (Allah) said: "I know that which you do not know."

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Behold, thy Lord said to the angels: "I will create a vicegerent on earth." They said: "Wilt Thou place therein one who will make mischief therein and shed blood?- whilst we do celebrate Thy praises and glorify Thy holy (name)?" He said: "I know what ye know not."

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: And when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to place a viceroy in the earth, they said: Wilt thou place therein one who will do harm therein and will shed blood, while we, we hymn Thy praise and sanctify Thee? He said: Surely I know that which ye know not.

ayahs.arabic: وَعَلَّمَ ءَادَمَ ٱلْأَسْمَآءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنۢبِـُٔونِى بِأَسْمَآءِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa 'allama Aadamal asmaaa'a kullahaa summa 'aradahum 'alal malaaa'ikati faqaala ambi'oonee bias maaa'i haaa'ulaaa'i in kuntum saadiqeen

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: And He taught Adam the names, all of them; then he presented them to the angels, and said, “Tell Me the names of these, if you are sincere.”

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: And He taught Adam all the names (of everything), then He showed them to the angels and said, "Tell Me the names of these if you are truthful."

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: And He taught Adam the names of all things; then He placed them before the angels, and said: "Tell me the names of these if ye are right."

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: And He taught Adam all the names, then showed them to the angels, saying: Inform Me of the names of these, if ye are truthful.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo subhaanaka laa 'ilma lanaaa illaa maa 'allamtanaaa innaka antal'aleemul hakeem

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise."

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: They said, “Glory be to You! We have no knowledge except what You have taught us. It is you who are the Knowledgeable, the Wise.”

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: They (angels) said: "Glory be to You, we have no knowledge except what you have taught us. Verily, it is You, the All-Knower, the All-Wise."

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: They said: "Glory to Thee, of knowledge We have none, save what Thou Hast taught us: In truth it is Thou Who art perfect in knowledge and wisdom."

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: They said: Be glorified! We have no knowledge saving that which Thou hast taught us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower, the Wise.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ أَنۢبِئْهُم بِأَسْمَآئِهِمْ ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَنۢبَأَهُم بِأَسْمَآئِهِمْ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala yaaa Aadamu ambi' hum biasmaaa'ihimfalammaaa amba ahum bi asmaaa'ihim qaala alam aqul lakum inneee a'lamu ghaibas samaawaati wal ardi wa a'lamu maa tubdoona wa maa kuntum taktumoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed."

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: He said, “O Adam, tell them their names.” And when he told them their names, He said, “Did I not tell you that I know the secrets of the heavens and the earth, and that I know what you reveal and what you conceal?”

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: He said: "O Adam! Inform them of their names," and when he had informed them of their names, He said: "Did I not tell you that I know the Ghaib (unseen) in the heavens and the earth, and I know what you reveal and what you have been concealing?"

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: He said: "O Adam! Tell them their names." When he had told them, Allah said: "Did I not tell you that I know the secrets of heaven and earth, and I know what ye reveal and what ye conceal?"

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: He said: O Adam! Inform them of their names, and when he had informed them of their names, He said: Did I not tell you that I know the secret of the heavens and the earth? And I know that which ye disclose and which ye hide.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa iz qulnaa lilmalaaa'i katis judoo liAadama fasajadooo illaaa Ibleesa abaa wastakbara wa kaana minal kaafireen

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: And We said to the angels, “Bow down to Adam.” They bowed down, except for Satan. He refused, was arrogant, and was one of the disbelievers.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: And (remember) when We said to the angels: "Prostrate yourselves before Adam.". And they prostrated except Iblis (Satan), he refused and was proud and was one of the disbelievers (disobedient to Allah).

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: And behold, We said to the angels: "Bow down to Adam" and they bowed down. Not so Iblis: he refused and was haughty: He was of those who reject Faith.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: And when We said unto the angels: Prostrate yourselves before Adam, they fell prostrate, all save Iblis. He demurred through pride, and so became a disbeliever.

ayahs.arabic: وَقُلْنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنْهَا رَغَدًا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa qulnaa yaaa Aadamus kun anta wa zawjukal jannata wa kulaa minhaa raghadan haisu shi'tumaa wa laa taqabaa haazihish shajarata fatakoonaa minaz zaalimeen

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: We said, “O Adam, inhabit the Garden, you and your spouse, and eat from it freely as you please, but do not approach this tree, lest you become wrongdoers.”

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: And We said: "O Adam! Dwell you and your wife in the Paradise and eat both of you freely with pleasure and delight of things therein as wherever you will, but come not near this tree or you both will be of the Zalimun (wrong-doers)."

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: We said: "O Adam! dwell thou and thy wife in the Garden; and eat of the bountiful things therein as (where and when) ye will; but approach not this tree, or ye run into harm and transgression."

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: And We said: O Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife in the Garden, and eat ye freely (of the fruits) thereof where ye will; but come not nigh this tree lest ye become wrong-doers.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَزَلَّهُمَا ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ عَنْهَا فَأَخْرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيهِ ۖ وَقُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّۭ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّۭ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa azallahumash Shaitaanu 'anhaa fa akhrajahumaa mimmaa kaanaa fee wa qulnah bitoo ba'dukum liba'din 'aduwwunw wa lakum fil ardi mustaqarrunw wa mataa'un ilaa heen

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: But Satan caused them to slip from it, and caused them to depart the state they were in. We said, “Go down, some of you enemies of one another. And you will have residence on earth, and enjoyment for a while.”

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Then the Shaitan (Satan) made them slip therefrom (the Paradise), and got them out from that in which they were. We said: "Get you down, all, with enmity between yourselves. On earth will be a dwelling place for you and an enjoyment for a time."

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Then did Satan make them slip from the (garden), and get them out of the state (of felicity) in which they had been. We said: "Get ye down, all (ye people), with enmity between yourselves. On earth will be your dwelling-place and your means of livelihood - for a time."

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: But Satan caused them to deflect therefrom and expelled them from the (happy) state in which they were; and We said: Fall down, one of you a foe unto the other! There shall be for you on earth a habitation and provision for a time.

ayahs.arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.transliteration: Fatalaqqaaa Aadamu mir Rabbihee Kalimaatin fataaba 'alayh; innahoo Huwat Tawwaabur Raheem

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: Then Adam received words from his Lord, so He relented towards him. He is the Relenting, the Merciful.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: Then Adam received from his Lord Words. And his Lord pardoned him (accepted his repentance). Verily, He is the One Who forgives (accepts repentance), the Most Merciful.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: Then learnt Adam from his Lord words of inspiration, and his Lord Turned towards him; for He is Oft-Returning, Most Merciful.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: Then Adam received from his Lord words (of revelation), and He relented toward him. Lo! He is the relenting, the Merciful.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًۭى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qulnah bitoo minhaa jamee 'an fa immaa yaatiyannakum minnee hudan faman tabi'a hudaaya falaa khawfun 'alaihim wa laa hum yahza noon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: We said, “Go down from it, all of you. Yet whenever guidance comes to you from Me, then whoever follows My guidance—they have nothing to fear, nor shall they grieve.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: We said: "Get down all of you from this place (the Paradise), then whenever there comes to you Guidance from Me, and whoever follows My Guidance, there shall be no fear on them, nor shall they grieve.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: We said: "Get ye down all from here; and if, as is sure, there comes to you Guidance from me, whosoever follows My guidance, on them shall be no fear, nor shall they grieve.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: We said: Go down, all of you, from hence; but verily there cometh unto you from Me a guidance; and whoso followeth My guidance, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallazeena kafaroo wa kaz zabooo bi aayaatinaa ulaaa'ika Ashaabun Naari hum feehaa khaalidoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: But as for those who disbelieve and reject Our signs—these are the inmates of the Fire—wherein they will remain forever.”

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: But those who disbelieve and belie Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) such are the dwellers of the Fire, they shall abide therein forever.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: "But those who reject Faith and belie Our Signs, they shall be companions of the Fire; they shall abide therein."

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: But they who disbelieve, and deny Our revelations, such are rightful Peoples of the Fire. They will abide therein.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِعَهْدِىٓ أُوفِ بِعَهْدِكُمْ وَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa Baneee Israaa'eelaz kuroo ni'matiyal lateee an'amtu 'alaikum wa awfoo bi'Ahdeee oofi bi ahdikum wa iyyaaya farhaboon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: O Children of Israel! Remember My blessings which I bestowed upon you, and fulfill your pledge to Me, and I will fulfill My pledge to you, and fear Me.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
hilali.author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
hilali.source: Published by King Fahd Complex for Printing the Holy Quran
hilali.text: O Children of Israel! Remember My Favour which I bestowed upon you, and fulfill (your obligations to) My Covenant (with you) so that I fulfill (My Obligations to) your covenant (with Me), and fear none but Me.

yusufali.name: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.author: Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.source: Published Historical Translation by Abdullah Yusuf Ali
yusufali.text: O Children of Israel! call to mind the (special) favour which I bestowed upon you, and fulfil your covenant with Me as I fulfil My Covenant with you, and fear none but Me.

pickthall.name: Pickthall
pickthall.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
pickthall.source: Published Translation: The Meaning of the Glorious Quran
pickthall.text: O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you, and fulfil your (part of the) covenant, I shall fulfil My (part of the) covenant, and fear Me.

ayahs.arabic: وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِمَآ أَنزَلْتُ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ وَلَا تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَوَّلَ كَافِرٍۭ بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِى ثَمَنًۭا قَلِيلًۭا وَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱتَّقُونِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa aaminoo bimaaa anzaltu musaddiqal limaa ma'akum wa laa takoonooo awwala kaafirim bihee wa laa tashtaroo bi Aayaatee samanan qaleelanw wa iyyaaya fattaqoon

sahih.name: Saheeh International
sahih.author: Saheeh International
sahih.source: Published by Dar Abul-Qasim / Quran.com Verified Dataset
sahih.text: And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me.

itani.name: Clear Qur'an
itani.author: Talal Itani
itani.source: Published Translation by Talal Itani / AlQuran Cloud
itani.text: And believe in what I revealed, confirming what is with you; and do not be the first to deny it; and do not exchange My revelations for a small price; and be conscious of Me.

hilali.name: Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhsin Khan
